Data Engineer
Trading under Publicis Communications
Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane

Data Engineer (also known as BI Developer, Quantitative Data Engineer, Search Engineer, Technical Architect, Big Data Analyst, Solutions Architect, Data Warehouse Engineer, Data Science Software Engineer, ETL Developer)
The role of the Data Engineer is to work alongside solution architects, data analysts & data scientists to deliver various aspects of the marketing technology ecosystem. The Data Engineer is responsible for engaging machine learning techniques to create and sustain structures that allow for the analysis of data whilst remaining familiar with dominant programming and deployment strategies. Data engineering experience is critical, as well as knowledge of data warehousing, ETL strategies and tools, and BI tools. Experience in cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS and GCP is beneficial.
Data Engineer Responsibilities:
•	Anticipating and mitigating delivery risks and following issues through to closure
•	Advocating for data management methodologies and processes on all projects
•	Assuming responsibility for data quality, ensuring that testing is carried out in a rigorous fashion resulting in production of high-quality deliverables
•	Adopting a flexible approach to completing workload to ensuring timely delivery and reinforcing commitment to delivery and quality within the technical team, including offshore development centres 
•	Creating and managing the relevant technical design documentation and ensures the documents completeness and accuracy
•	Ensuring that data architecture is implemented according to the design 
•	Ensuring solutions delivered use existing standards and frameworks
•	Contributing to business development efforts through accurate project scoping, estimating and attending sales calls when required
•	Collaborating with globally dispersed teams on international projects.  This includes co-ordinating build activities with offshore development centres in India and Asia Pacific
•	Remaining up-to-date with industry standards and technological advancements that will improve the quality of your outputs.
Data Engineer Requirements:
•	All of the above roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.
•	Proven experience as a data engineer, software developer, or similar.
•	Expert proficiency in Python, C++, Java, R, and SQL.
•	Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
•	Works well independently but also a team player and able to work collaboratively
•	Scrupulous approach to duties.
•	Strong presentation and written communication skills, with ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical colleagues and clients
•	Experience developing data processing and analytics solutions in a digital agency or IT consultancy as part of a multi-disciplinary team

result.description: Mansys Pty Ltd   Software Developer   Mansys Pty Ltd is recruiting on behalf of Sonar Technologies International   Location:  Macquarie Park, NSW   Employment Type:  Full-time, Permanent   Salary:  $80,000–$90,000 plus superannuation, depending on skills and experience   About the Company   Sonar Technologies International is an Australian technology company specialising in enterprise mobility and smart business solutions.  Sonar develops and implements software products that automate operational workflows across transport and logistics, mobile workforce management, warehousing, field services, retail and healthcare. Its solutions provide capabilities such as job scheduling, dispatch management, route optimisation, real-time tracking, inventory management, reporting and integration with existing ERP and CRM platforms.   About the Role   The role will primarily involve C# and .NET application development, API integration, database-driven software solutions and the deployment of applications through modern cloud and container environments.   Key Responsibilities    Analyse business requirements, functional specifications and existing application workflows.  Develop, maintain and enhance software applications using C#, .NET and related technologies.  Design, develop and test APIs used to integrate Sonar applications with customer, ERP, CRM and third-party systems.  Write maintainable and appropriately documented program code in accordance with technical specifications and development standards.  Identify limitations and deficiencies in existing applications and recommend suitable software improvements.  Test, debug and correct application errors to ensure systems perform reliably and according to specification.  Assist in upgrading legacy .NET applications and APIs to current frameworks and development standards.  Develop and maintain database-driven functionality using SQL and relational database technologies.  Develop and maintain automated build, testing and deployment processes through CI/CD pipelines.  Assist with the deployment and operation of applications in cloud environments such as Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure or AWS.  Monitor application performance, investigate runtime issues and implement software-level fixes.  Develop internal utilities and automation tools using technologies such as Python, Go, PowerShell or Bash.  Prepare and maintain technical documentation, deployment instructions and operational procedures.  Work with software architects, developers, project teams and support personnel throughout the software development lifecycle.    Qualifications and Experience    Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering or a closely related discipline.  At least one year of relevant software development or closely related commercial experience.  Practical experience developing applications or APIs using C# and .NET.  Experience with REST APIs and system integration.  Familiarity with cloud platforms such as GCP, Azure or AWS.  Familiarity with CI/CD tools and source-control platforms such as Bitbucket or Git.    Desirable Skills    Experience modernising legacy .NET applications.  Experience developing software for logistics, workforce management, warehousing, healthcare or other operational environments.  Knowledge of real-time data processing, GPS, mobile applications, reporting systems or ERP/CRM integration.  Experience with Python, Go, PowerShell or Bash scripting.  Understanding of application monitoring tools and cloud-based observability  Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.         About Company    Mansys is an Australian recruitment service focused on tradespeople and other in-demand workers. It supports roles across trades, automotive, hospitality, care services, agriculture, and manufacturing. result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Transform lives, every single day 

Do you want a career that means more? At Anglicare Sydney, we bring the strength, the support and the strategy to make it happen. 

We're a well-respected not-for-profit that's been serving society's most vulnerable for more than 160 years. Each year, we achieve life-changing outcomes for the 40,000+ people who rely on our person-centred support. And now, we're extending our reach and impact even further. 

As an Integration Developer, you'll play a key role in delivering secure, scalable and efficient technology solutions that support our mission. You'll be welcomed into a compassionate, respectful and purpose-driven community where we don't just talk about values - we live them. 

Your opportunity 

You will design, develop and maintain enterprise integration solutions that connect Anglicare's systems and services. Working closely with stakeholders across IT, Finance, Payroll, PaC and Facilities, you'll ensure our data flows securely and reliably to support business operations. 

With integrity and resilience, you will: 

Collaborate with business units to gather and document integration requirements 

Develop and maintain Logic App integrations aligned with enterprise architecture and security standards 

Deliver robust, well-tested solutions using Azure services including API Management and Functions 

Monitor and optimise the Enterprise Application Integration (EAI) platform 

Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues, ensuring minimal disruption to services 

Maintain system and data security, including access controls and disaster recovery documentation 

Support stakeholders with integration needs and provide clear, timely communication 

What you'll bring 

You are a detail-oriented, technically capable developer who thrives in a collaborative environment. You bring strong experience in Azure integration technologies and a passion for building secure, scalable solutions. 

You will also need: 

A degree in IT or relevant industry experience 

2+ years' experience working in Azure and developing Logic Apps (or Power Automate) 

Experience with Azure API Management, Azure Functions, REST-SOAP APIs and Postman 

Familiarity with CI-CD pipelines and code repositories 

Strong communication and documentation skills 

Experience integrating with Workday HCM and using Workday Studio (desirable)

Build the software that protects our most security-conscious organisations.

Most software developers improve products. Here, you'll help redefine them. At Janusnet, our software protects some of Australia's most security-conscious organisations across government, defence and critical infrastructure.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an experienced Senior C++ / COM Developer to modernise existing products, help shape our next generation of security solutions, and bring entirely new products to market.

If you're looking for a role where your ideas influence product direction not just sprint tickets this is it.

The Perks

    Hybrid working (50/50 between home and our North Sydney office)
    Build new cybersecurity products from the ground up
    Variety across architecture, product development, innovation and emerging technologies
    Job stability and growth 

What You'll Be Doing
You'll play a key role in modernising our existing suite of trusted security solutions while designing and developing new products that respond to evolving customer needs and emerging technologies.

Working across the full software development lifecycle, you'll build secure, high-quality Windows applications using C++ and COM, applying Secure by Design principles to solutions relied upon by government, defence and critical infrastructure organisations.

Along the way, you'll collaborate with talented engineers and cross-functional teams, influence technical direction and product strategy, and contribute to a culture of innovation as we continue to expand and bring new ideas to market.

What We're Looking For:

    Extensive commercial C++ development experience
    Strong Microsoft COM and Windows development
    Experience across the full software development lifecycle Experience building commercial software productsSecure software development experience
    Experience with server and endpoint security products, security frameworks like Secure by Design, NIST or compliance standards DISP or ISM will put you well ahead.

Australian Citizenship is essential, along with the ability to obtain a Baseline Security Clearance.

Why Janusnet?

For more than 20 years, Janusnet has been developing trusted information security solutions used by government, defence and commercial organisations across Australia and around the world.

We're big enough to work on complex, meaningful security challenges, but still small enough that every engineer has genuine influence over the products we build.

Here, you'll have the opportunity to challenge ideas, innovate, and help shape technology that protects organisations where security matters most.

If you're ready to build software that genuinely makes a difference, and want the opportunity to influence products from concept through to release we'd love to hear from you!

For a confidential discussion, connect with Victoria Williams on 03 9691 4712.

Ready chart a new course?

Key Responsibilities:
• Review software requirements and specifications to understand the scope and identify potential areas of concern.
• Develop comprehensive test plans and strategies outlining the objectives, resources, schedule, and scope of testing activities.
• Design and write detailed test cases and test scripts to validate software functionality, performance, and security.
• Conduct manual and automated tests to evaluate the software's performance, identify bugs, and ensure compliance with requirements.
• Document and report identified defects clearly and concisely, providing detailed information to assist developers in reproduction and resolution.
• Perform regression tests to confirm that recent code changes have not adversely affected existing functionalities.
• Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand product features and ensure comprehensive test coverage.
• Develop and maintain automated test scripts to enhance testing efficiency and coverage.
• Maintain detailed records of test procedures, test cases, and test results. Prepare reports summarizing testing activities and outcomes.

Qualifications:
• A bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field is typically required.
• Minimum 2+ years of experience in manual and automation testing.
• Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, tools, and processes. Experience with test automation tools is a plus.
• Excellent problem-solving abilities with a keen attention to detail. Ability to think critically and analytically to identify potential issues.
• Effective verbal and written communication skills to articulate test results and collaborate with team members.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities and requirements.
• Professional certifications such as ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board) or CSTE (Certified Software Tester) are advantageous.
